dialogues.jp:
携帯電話の液晶で日付を確認して、俺は小さく
ため息をついた。
dialogues.en: After checking today's date on my cell phone, I give a sigh.
dialogues.text: After checking today's date on my cell phone, I give a sigh.

dialogues.jp: 「あれから５日か……」
dialogues.en: "It's been five days since then..."
dialogues.text: "It's been five days since then..."

dialogues.jp: 午前の公園を歩きながら、青い空を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
I look up the blue sky, as I walk around the park in the
morning.
dialogues.text:
I look up the blue sky, as I walk around the park in the
morning.

dialogues.jp: 最近、毎日のように呟いている言葉だ。
dialogues.en: I use this word all the time these days.
dialogues.text: I use this word all the time these days.

dialogues.jp:
あの日の出来事がまるごと夢ならばとも思うの
だが、ここまで来ると認めるしかないらしい。
dialogues.en:
I wish that event was a dream, but I guess I have no choice
but to accept it at this point.
dialogues.text:
I wish that event was a dream, but I guess I have no choice
but to accept it at this point.

dialogues.jp: 唇に指を当てる。
dialogues.en: I put a finger to my lips.
dialogues.text: I put a finger to my lips.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、桜の花びらのような、音夢のぬくも
りが残っているようだった。
dialogues.en:
I can feel Nemu's warmth... the warmth of a cherry blossom
petal.
dialogues.text:
I can feel Nemu's warmth... the warmth of a cherry blossom
petal.

dialogues.jp: 「俺を気にしてるな……音夢」
dialogues.en: "I know she is self-conscious about me."
dialogues.text: "I know she is self-conscious about me."

dialogues.jp: 自宅の方角を見やる。
dialogues.en: I look in the direction of my house.
dialogues.text: I look in the direction of my house.

dialogues.jp:
離れた場所で、音夢が俺のことを気にしている
のが分かる。
dialogues.en:
I can feel Nemu is very anxious about us even from a long
way away.
dialogues.text:
I can feel Nemu is very anxious about us even from a long
way away.

dialogues.jp:
バカげた話だが、あいつと俺の心が繋がってい
る感じだ。
dialogues.en:
It sounds ridiculous, but I feel like our minds are
connected.
dialogues.text:
It sounds ridiculous, but I feel like our minds are
connected.

dialogues.jp: 「……痛いな」
dialogues.en: "It hurts."
dialogues.text: "It hurts."

dialogues.jp: 胸がズキズキと鈍くうずく。
dialogues.en: I feel a clenching in my heart.
dialogues.text: I feel a clenching in my heart.

dialogues.jp: あいつも同じ痛みを感じているとしたらバカだ。
dialogues.en: It's crazy to think she could feel the same way.
dialogues.text: It's crazy to think she could feel the same way.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉先輩っ、おはよーです！」
dialogues.en: "Good morning to you, Asakura-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning to you, Asakura-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん、よぉ。どうしたんだこんなところで」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, hey. What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, hey. What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩こそどうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on?"

dialogues.jp: ははは、と元気良く美春が駆け寄ってくる。
dialogues.en: Miharu's running toward me energetically.
dialogues.text: Miharu's running toward me energetically.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「杉並先輩の家にでも遊びに行くんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going to Suginami-sempai's house?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going to Suginami-sempai's house?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前、そんな怖いこと言うなよ……」
dialogues.en: "That's a scary thing to say."
dialogues.text: "That's a scary thing to say."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、杉並の家なんてこの島に存在して
いるのだろうか。
dialogues.en: I wonder if Suginami has a house on this island.
dialogues.text: I wonder if Suginami has a house on this island.

dialogues.jp: 地下か？
dialogues.en: Underground?
dialogues.text: Underground?

dialogues.jp: 「で、美春はなにやってんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what are you doing here, Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "So, what are you doing here, Miharu?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ……春休みになると、この公園でわ
　んちゃんを散歩してる人が増えるんですよ！」
dialogues.en:
"Teehee, when the spring comes, more people walk their dogs
in this park."
dialogues.text:
"Teehee, when the spring comes, more people walk their dogs
in this park."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わんこ？」
dialogues.en: "A doggy?"
dialogues.text: "A doggy?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「わんこです！　ぎゅって抱きしめると暖かい
　のです！」
dialogues.en: "Yes, a doggy! You feel so warm when you hold them."
dialogues.text: "Yes, a doggy! You feel so warm when you hold them."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そんないばるなよ」
dialogues.en: "Well, you don't need to brag about that."
dialogues.text: "Well, you don't need to brag about that."

dialogues.jp:
わけが分からなかったが、なんとなく見ていて
元気の出るやつだ。
dialogues.en:
I don't know why she enthuses about dogs, but she can cheer
people up by just looking at her.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why she enthuses about dogs, but she can cheer
people up by just looking at her.

dialogues.jp: 「いいやつだな美春は。なにも問題がない」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu is such a nice person. She doesn't have any
problems."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu is such a nice person. She doesn't have any
problems."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、こっちの話だ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, nothing."
dialogues.text: "Oh, nothing."

dialogues.jp: ぽん、と美春の頭を叩く。
dialogues.en: I tap her on the head lightly.
dialogues.text: I tap her on the head lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、どうせだから、このまま朝倉先輩の家に
　遊びに行こうかな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, here I am. I may come and visit the Asakura
residence."
dialogues.text:
"Well, here I am. I may come and visit the Asakura
residence."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「うち？」
dialogues.en: "My house?"
dialogues.text: "My house?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「春休みになって、音夢先輩ともそんなに顔を
　合わせてないですからね」
dialogues.en: "Since the spring break began, I haven't seen Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Since the spring break began, I haven't seen Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お目当ては音夢か」
dialogues.en: "Is Nemu your main reason?"
dialogues.text: "Is Nemu your main reason?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春と音夢先輩の愛は朝倉先輩でも止められ
　ません。残念でしたね〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, but you can't stop our love!"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but you can't stop our love!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「残念じゃねぇよ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing to feel sorry about."
dialogues.text: "Nothing to feel sorry about."

dialogues.jp: ぐい、と美春の頭を鷲づかみにする。
dialogues.en: I grab Miharu's head with my palms.
dialogues.text: I grab Miharu's head with my palms.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いたたたた！」
dialogues.en: "Ouch!"
dialogues.text: "Ouch!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ぬ、さくらより掴み辛いな」
dialogues.en:
"Oh gosh, your head is hard to grab, it's worse than
Sakura's."
dialogues.text:
"Oh gosh, your head is hard to grab, it's worse than
Sakura's."

dialogues.jp: ずるり、と美春の頭が手から抜けてしまう。
dialogues.en: Miharu's head easily pulled out from my hands.
dialogues.text: Miharu's head easily pulled out from my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、さくらって、芳乃先輩ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Sakura means Yoshino-sempai, right?"
dialogues.text: "Sakura means Yoshino-sempai, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらに先輩という呼称をつけると、なんか耳
がムズムズするな……。
dialogues.en:
When you associate the word 'sempai' with Sakura's name, it
sounds very weird.
dialogues.text:
When you associate the word 'sempai' with Sakura's name, it
sounds very weird.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、美春からさくらの名前が出るなんて
　な。知り合いなのか？」
dialogues.en:
"I never expected to hear Sakura's name from you. Do you
know each other?"
dialogues.text:
"I never expected to hear Sakura's name from you. Do you
know each other?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、ちょっと小耳に挟んだくらいですけど」
dialogues.en: "No, I just heard in passing, that's all."
dialogues.text: "No, I just heard in passing, that's all."

dialogues.jp: ごにょごにょ、と美春が声をつぶす。
dialogues.en: Miharu murmurs.
dialogues.text: Miharu murmurs.

dialogues.jp: 「どこで小耳に挟んだんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you hear it?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you hear it?"

dialogues.jp:
キャラというのか、誰にでもよく懐くので美春
の交友関係は広い。
dialogues.en: Miharu has many friends because of her friendly character.
dialogues.text: Miharu has many friends because of her friendly character.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どこで……えーとどこだっけなぁ。あははは。
　忘れてしまいましたよ。もぅ、美春ったらド
　ジなんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Um... where was it? Um... hahaha, I forgot. I'm such a
klutz!"
dialogues.text:
"Um... where was it? Um... hahaha, I forgot. I'm such a
klutz!"

dialogues.jp: こつん、と自分で自分の頭を叩く。
dialogues.en: She taps her head by herself.
dialogues.text: She taps her head by herself.

dialogues.jp:
「……どうやら、そのオレンジ色の頭を赤く染
　めてもらいたいらしいな」
dialogues.en:
"Looks like you want to dye red into your orange hair, don't
you?"
dialogues.text:
"Looks like you want to dye red into your orange hair, don't
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「言います！　言いますから、ミシミシやらな
　いでください……しくしく」
dialogues.en: "I'll tell you! I'll tell you, so please stop that..."
dialogues.text: "I'll tell you! I'll tell you, so please stop that..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、そんなに悪い噂なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it a bad rumor?"
dialogues.text: "Is it a bad rumor?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あのですねぇ……本当に噂ですからね」
dialogues.en: "Um... This is only a rumor, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Um... This is only a rumor, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、バイト帰りに桜の枝が頭にぶつかった、
　風紀委員の子がいたじゃないですか」
dialogues.en:
"Do you remember the girl in the discipline committee who
got hurt with a cherry branch on her head on the way home
from her part time job?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you remember the girl in the discipline committee who
got hurt with a cherry branch on her head on the way home
from her part time job?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、いたなそんなのも。卒業式の前あたり
　に電話があった」
dialogues.en:
"Oh yeah, I remember there was a phone call about her just
before the graduation ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"Oh yeah, I remember there was a phone call about her just
before the graduation ceremony."

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず自分の家に帰るルートを歩きながら
頷く。
dialogues.en: I nod at her while I walk home.
dialogues.text: I nod at her while I walk home.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、美春の友達なんですけど。その子が芳
　乃先輩を見たって言うんですよ」
dialogues.en: "She is my friend, and she said she saw Yoshino-sempai."
dialogues.text: "She is my friend, and she said she saw Yoshino-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だから、自分が頭を打ったときに、桜の木の
　影から芳乃先輩がじっと｛にら／睨｝んでたって」
dialogues.en:
"And she said when the girl hit her head, Yoshino-sempai was
watching her from behind the cherry tree."
dialogues.text:
"And she said when the girl hit her head, Yoshino-sempai was
watching her from behind the cherry tree."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、さくらがやったっていうのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you saying Sakura did it?"
dialogues.text: "Are you saying Sakura did it?"

dialogues.jp: あんまりにも、あんまりな内容に呆れてしまう。
dialogues.en: I am dumbfounded at this outrageous rumor.
dialogues.text: I am dumbfounded at this outrageous rumor.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、あれは自然に折れたものだって、警察
　の人も言っていましたからねぇ」
dialogues.en:
"No, not at all. Even the police said it was a natural cause
when the branch broke."
dialogues.text:
"No, not at all. Even the police said it was a natural cause
when the branch broke."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「って言うか、あいつは、面と向かって蹴飛ば
　してくることはあるけど、そういう姑息な手
　段はないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"I know she might attack her from the front, but she would
never do underhanded things like that."
dialogues.text:
"I know she might attack her from the front, but she would
never do underhanded things like that."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「面と向かって蹴られても困りますけどね」
dialogues.en: "It's not good either if she attacks from the front."
dialogues.text: "It's not good either if she attacks from the front."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、俺以外にはやらないだろうけど……
　でも、その子とさくらに面識なんてないだ
　ろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, she wouldn't do it to anyone else but me... but does
Sakura know her?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, she wouldn't do it to anyone else but me... but does
Sakura know her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それが、バイト中に怒らせちゃったら
　しいんですよ。子供扱いして」
dialogues.en:
"Well I heard she made Yoshino-sempai angry by treating her
like a child at her part-time job."
dialogues.text:
"Well I heard she made Yoshino-sempai angry by treating her
like a child at her part-time job."

dialogues.jp: ピン、と指を立てる。
dialogues.en: I nod.
dialogues.text: I nod.

dialogues.jp:
「あぁチビだから……ん？　どこかで聞いた話
　だな？」
dialogues.en:
"I see... because she is a shorty. I heard the story
somewhere."
dialogues.text:
"I see... because she is a shorty. I heard the story
somewhere."

dialogues.jp: バイト中に子ども扱いして怒らせた？
dialogues.en: Somebody made Sakura upset at the workplace?
dialogues.text: Somebody made Sakura upset at the workplace?

dialogues.jp:
「あ、おい、その子って商店街の茶屋でバイト
　してるやつか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, does she work at the cafe in the shopping center?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, does she work at the cafe in the shopping center?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、知ってるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know her?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know her?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、へぇ、そっか」
dialogues.en: "Aahh, hmm... I see."
dialogues.text: "Aahh, hmm... I see."

dialogues.jp: あの時の子だったか。
dialogues.en: That was her that time.
dialogues.text: That was her that time.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、まんざら繋がりがないわけじゃないん
　だ」
dialogues.en: "I can't say I have no connection with her."
dialogues.text: "I can't say I have no connection with her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、芳乃先輩って目が青かったり小柄だっ
　たりで神秘的ですから、そういう噂が立つん
　ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I think people spread the rumor because of Yoshino-sempai's
blue eyes, and her small frame... I mean, she has a very
mysterious figure for sure."
dialogues.text:
"I think people spread the rumor because of Yoshino-sempai's
blue eyes, and her small frame... I mean, she has a very
mysterious figure for sure."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「神秘的というより密輸入された珍獣だけどな」
dialogues.en:
"I'd say perhaps an exotic animal imported from somewhere,
rather than a mysterious figure."
dialogues.text:
"I'd say perhaps an exotic animal imported from somewhere,
rather than a mysterious figure."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「青い瞳って憧れますよね〜。美春は地味です
　から、先輩方みたいに美人だったり特徴的だ
　と良いんですけどね〜」
dialogues.en:
"I wish I had blue eyes. I have a simple image, but it's
nice to have a certain beauty like her."
dialogues.text:
"I wish I had blue eyes. I have a simple image, but it's
nice to have a certain beauty like her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「地味？」
dialogues.en: "Simple?"
dialogues.text: "Simple?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「地味地味ですよ〜」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I have a super simple look."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I have a super simple look."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前が地味地味？」
dialogues.en: "Are you super simple?"
dialogues.text: "Are you super simple?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「地味も地味、キング・オブ・地味ですね」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah, I'm the king of simplicity."
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah, I'm the king of simplicity."

dialogues.jp: そうか、俺の地味の認識が甘かったらしい。
dialogues.en: I see. I guess I have the wrong idea about simplicity.
dialogues.text: I see. I guess I have the wrong idea about simplicity.

dialogues.jp:
「しかし女の子ってのは、不思議とか特別なも
　んによく憧れたりするなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"I don't understand why girls admire something strange,
different from the rest."
dialogues.text:
"I don't understand why girls admire something strange,
different from the rest."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「男の子だってそうじゃないですか。マンガみ
　たいな冒険とかしたくありません？」
dialogues.en:
"I think boys do the same thing like trying to go on
adventures like you see in the comic books."
dialogues.text:
"I think boys do the same thing like trying to go on
adventures like you see in the comic books."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「いや、むしろギャルゲ……いや、なんでもな
　い」
dialogues.en: "Well, we are more into erotic ga- Ah, nothing."
dialogues.text: "Well, we are more into erotic ga- Ah, nothing."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、やっぱり先輩はそういう方面なんです
　ねぇ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Erotic games?"
dialogues.text: "Erotic games?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……さらりと流せよ」
dialogues.en: "Let it go."
dialogues.text: "Let it go."

dialogues.jp: つーか、なんでその手の話題を知ってんだよ。
dialogues.en: How did you find out about that stuff?
dialogues.text: How did you find out about that stuff?

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あははは。朝倉先輩の立場なんて、そのまん
　まじゃないですかぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha... It's not difficult to see through you,
Asakura-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha... It's not difficult to see through you,
Asakura-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「可愛い妹とか、再会した幼なじみとか」
dialogues.en:
"Your loving sister, and a childhood friend that you've been
reunited with."
dialogues.text:
"Your loving sister, and a childhood friend that you've been
reunited with."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ベタやなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Jesus Christ..."
dialogues.text: "Jesus Christ..."

dialogues.jp: 自覚はしているが、改めて面倒だな……。
dialogues.en:
I know what they mean, but it's a pain in the neck to think
about.
dialogues.text:
I know what they mean, but it's a pain in the neck to think
about.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お約束の三角関係ですね。あとは、猫耳とか
　メイドさんも欲しいですか？」
dialogues.en:
"It's a forbidden love triangle, isn't it? Do you like cat's
ears or a personal maid?"
dialogues.text:
"It's a forbidden love triangle, isn't it? Do you like cat's
ears or a personal maid?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……詳しすぎるぞお前。やってんのか？」
dialogues.en: "How do you know that so much? Are you into it?"
dialogues.text: "How do you know that so much? Are you into it?"

dialogues.jp: 微妙に美春と距離をとってしまう。
dialogues.en: I subtly step back from Miharu.
dialogues.text: I subtly step back from Miharu.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春はやりませんよ〜。お父さんがそういう
　話をたまにするんです」
dialogues.en:
"I don't do that, but my dad likes to talk about that
stuff."
dialogues.text:
"I don't do that, but my dad likes to talk about that
stuff."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ドリル萌え〜とか、触角萌え〜、って」
dialogues.en: "Drill sprouting, or touch sensation..."
dialogues.text: "Drill sprouting, or touch sensation..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
いい親父なのか、嫌な親父なのか微妙なところ
だ。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure if he's a good father or a nasty one.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if he's a good father or a nasty one.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「将来はメイドロボを作りたいそうです。でも、
　そのロボは炊事が出来てはいけないらしいん
　ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"He wants to create a maid robot someday, but it can't cook
at all."
dialogues.text:
"He wants to create a maid robot someday, but it can't cook
at all."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「……お父さんは大切にしないといけないな」
dialogues.en: "You take care of your dad."
dialogues.text: "You take care of your dad."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ですね〜」
dialogues.en: "Right."
dialogues.text: "Right."

dialogues.jp: 分かってるのか分かってないのか。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure she knows what it means.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure she knows what it means.

dialogues.jp:
もしかしたら、美春のこの性格って、父親に意
図的に方向をずらされたのでは……。
dialogues.en:
I wonder if her father changed her character to a different
direction deliberately.
dialogues.text:
I wonder if her father changed her character to a different
direction deliberately.

dialogues.jp: 俺は青い空に向かって拳を握り締めた。
dialogues.en: I made a tight fist toward the blue sky.
dialogues.text: I made a tight fist toward the blue sky.

dialogues.jp: お父さん、最高です。
dialogues.en: You did an awesome job, old man.
dialogues.text: You did an awesome job, old man.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらの噂◆
dialogues.en: ◆The rumor about Sakura◆
dialogues.text: ◆The rumor about Sakura◆

dialogues.jp:
音夢にキスを奪われてから、家に居辛くて外出
することが多くなった。仕方なく公園を散歩を
している最中、美春に出会う。
dialogues.en:
Since Nemu stole a kiss from me, I started to go out often
because I can't relax at home any more. When I was strolling
around in the park, I met Miharu.
dialogues.text:
Since Nemu stole a kiss from me, I started to go out often
because I can't relax at home any more. When I was strolling
around in the park, I met Miharu.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま家に音夢目当てで遊びに来ることになっ
た美春から、少し前に聞いた事故にあった女子
学生が知り合いだという話を聞く。
dialogues.en:
Miharu told me that the girl who had an accident was a
person we met before.
dialogues.text:
Miharu told me that the girl who had an accident was a
person we met before.

dialogues.jp:
なんでも、事故にあったときにさくらに会った
と言うのだが……アイツはそんなことはしない
と自信をもって否定した。
dialogues.en:
According to Miharu, the girl said she saw Sakura when the
accident occurred. But I said she was not the kind of person
to do that.
dialogues.text:
According to Miharu, the girl said she saw Sakura when the
accident occurred. But I said she was not the kind of person
to do that.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことよりも、美春のお父さんがメイドロ
ボを作ろうとしていることに、男の浪漫を感じ
ずにはいられなかった。
dialogues.en:
More importantly, when I heard Miharu's father is going to
create a maid robot, I was overwhelmed with a sense of man's
romanticism.
dialogues.text:
More importantly, when I heard Miharu's father is going to
create a maid robot, I was overwhelmed with a sense of man's
romanticism.
